text.en: Pet owners speak highly of the team at Pets Plus in Fermoy, commending their friendliness, product knowledge, and helpful service. Reviewers especially praise groomer Joanne for her patience and gentle reassurance when welcoming anxious pets. Both retail associates and grooming staff are described as accommodating and dedicated to animal welfare.

Multiple reviewers emphasize the gentle handling demonstrated when grooming cats, including long-haired breeds and pets with medical conditions. Clients note that groomers take time to keep nervous animals calm and comfortable without rushing sessions. Pet owners express immense relief seeing their feline companions relaxed during and after grooms.

Clients report excellent styling and maintenance outcomes following cat grooming appointments. Pet parents appreciate the meticulous care taken with long coats, gentle washing, and blow-drying without distressing their pets. Reviewers also highlight receiving helpful post-grooming tips to maintain coat condition between studio visits.

q.en: Does Pets Plus Fermoy offer specialized cat grooming?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the on-site studio for dedicated cat grooming, including long-haired and nervous felines.

q.en: Can staff assist with pet nutrition and dietary needs?

a.en: Yes, client reviews note that retail associates provide helpful recommendations on pet food brands and dietary requirements.

q.en: Where is the pet shop located in Fermoy?

a.en: The store is situated at Unit 7 within the Blackwater Shopping Centre on Dublin Road.

q.en: Can owners get advice on post-groom coat maintenance?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that the groomer provides clear advice on brushing and coat management between appointments.
